reviews.title: A True All-rounder CPU With Zero Compromises
reviews.comment: This CPU is finally the best of all worlds. I had a 9950X3D (which I just sold for almost the price I paid for it) and there were some random issues with the scheduler. In games I'd get some infrequent but significant stutters, which I found out was the scheduler sometimes switching to the non-3D CCD. I caught it red handed doing so during a few of the stutters. I'm happy to report that those stutters are now gone. In addition I'm also modeling the impact of shear force on protein denaturation, and this is showing a whopping 20-30% increase in that workload! I also noticed that at least for my CPU, both CCDs are running at the same exact speed under full load out of the box (5.1GHz). The old X3D had one CCD running 5.1 and the other at 4.9. This, again, avoids scheduler issues with the only holdup between both CCDs being the interconnect. I feel like this is AMD's first true all-rounder CPU where it can just do any workload thrown at it without compromising. The only thing I could ask for now is for improvements to the IMC such that 8000MT/s runs as easily as 6000 does today. That would be the ultimate package, but I digress, this is almost as good as it can get.

reviews.title: AMD HAS OFFICIALLY LOST THE PLOT
reviews.comment:
I was ready to drop $900 on this at launch, but AMD blacklisting Tech Jesus (Gamers Nexus) is an absolute coward move and a hard pass. You don’t shut out one of the most trusted voices in tech unless you’re terrified of the benchmarks
Let’s be honest for gaming, there is zero real world gain here over the 9950X3D, yet you’re asking $300+ more and that’s if you can even find it for MSRP, which isn't happening on this Amazon listing. AMD built its reputation on being the pro consumer alternative, but has clearly forgotten who put them on top. AMD is running the exact same anti consumer playbook as (Nvidia CEO) cousin Jensen Huang. You’ve become the very thing we hated. Keep it up, and watch how fast we take our money elsewhere. Disgraceful.
reviews.author: Axle
